init.title: AI Recipe Finder & voice input
init.description:
Turn AI recipe features on or off, and pick which AI Task entities power them. If AI is enabled but no text entity is chosen yet, the panel still shows the AI buttons and prompts the user to finish setup here.

Voice input adds a microphone button to the AI prompt and the dashboard card's search box, transcribing speech with the speech-to-text engine of the Assist pipeline you choose. Leave the pipeline empty to use your preferred one, and pick a Whisper-based pipeline rather than Speech-to-Phrase, which only recognises pre-defined phrases.

data.ai_text_entity: AI Task entity for recipe text
data.ai_image_entity: AI Task entity for recipe images (optional)
